evaluation.overall_comment: This is a functional and scientifically accurate translation that successfully captures the educational tone and content of the original podcast. It excels in preserving technical information and logical structure but suffers from noticeable fluency issues, including gender agreement errors, awkward idiomatic choices, and minor terminology inconsistencies. With light editorial polishing to fix syntax and naturalize phrasing, it would be publication-ready for a science communication audience.
